name: Dice and Dominoes
description: Dice and Dominoes is a western domino table game that combines domino connecting play with an auxiliary dice-driven table profile for pace or scoring. This entry models the connecting core using two double-six sets; dice effects are treated as a configurable profile layer rather than changing tile legality.
deck: Two double-6 domino sets (56 tiles) plus dice for the table profile

rules.objective: Play legal matching tiles and satisfy the match's hand-end and scoring profile, including any dice-driven constraints or scoring adjustments.
rules.gameplay: Players place a legal tile to a matching open end of the shared layout. Dice effects, if used, are applied by the table profile to constrain choices or modify scoring without changing the base rule that a placed tile must match an open end. Blocked turns resolve by drawing or passing as defined by the table profile.
keyRules: A tile placement must match the value of an open end.
Dice effects modify the profile layer, not the tile matching legality.
Blocked-turn handling and scoring depend on table profile.

strategy.basic: Maintain mobility with flexible tiles and avoid being trapped with high-pip exposure.
strategy.intermediate: Treat dice as a risk signal; keep options open so profile constraints do not strand your hand.
strategy.advanced: Use end control to shape the board into states that are favorable under the dice-driven profile incentives.
tips: Avoid narrow dependencies on a single value when dice can shift constraints abruptly.
Duplicate tiles reduce certainty; plan robustly rather than relying on unique-tile inference.
